map.击打硬度评估：力量得分 = min(100, 实测力量 ÷ 部位基准力量 × 1: Strike-hardness assessment: strength score = min(100, measured force ÷ baseline force for the part × 100); baselines like abdomen 600 N, chest 500 N, shin 1200 N; combined with pain tolerance and training years for an overall score.
map.武术或格斗训练中记录各部位的承受冲击力，按部位参考上限折算力量评分。: In martial arts or combat training, record the impact force each part sustains and convert it into a strength score using the part's reference maximum.
map.结合耐痛评分、恢复速度与训练年限，综合评估: Combine pain tolerance, recovery speed, and training years for
map.周期性复测同一部位，用综合分变化衡量训练效果。: Re-test the same part periodically and use changes in the overall score to measure training effect.
map.腹部参考上限 600 N：力量评分 = 450 ÷ 600 × 100 = 75: Abdomen reference maximum 600 N: strength score = 450 ÷ 600 × 100 = 75; pain tolerance 7/10 -> 70 points; recovery time 6 hours -> 100 − 6×10 = 40 points; 5 years of training -> min(100, 5×15) = 75 points. Overall = 75×0.35 + 70×0.25 + 40×0.20 + 75×0.20 = 66.8 points -> "Good (intermediate)". If recovery time is cut to 2 hours (recovery score 80), the overall rises to 74.8, reaching the "Excellent (advanced)" threshold.
map.各部位的参考上限是多少？: What are the reference maximums for each part?
map.腹部 600 N、胸部 500 N、胫骨 1 200 N、前臂 800 N、拳面: Abdomen 600 N, chest 500 N, shin 1,200 N, forearm 800 N, knuckle surface 1,000 N. These are empirical references, not safety standards; do not test beyond your capacity.
map.综合分的权重是怎样的？: How are the overall score weights set?
map.力量 35%、耐痛 25%、恢复 20%、训练年限 20%。力量权重最高，因为它: Strength 35%, pain tolerance 25%, recovery 20%, training years 20%. Strength carries the most weight because it is the most directly measurable indicator; recovery speed reflects the body's adaptation and also accounts for 20%.
map.抗击打训练应循序渐进，切忌急于求成: Conditioning training should progress gradually; never rush it
map.胫骨和前臂是最常训练的抗击打部位: The shin and forearm are the most commonly conditioned parts
map.训练前应充分热身，训练后及时冰敷和恢复: Warm up thoroughly before training and apply ice and recover promptly afterward
map.疼痛耐受评分7分以上为良好水平: A pain tolerance score of 7 or above is a good level
map.恢复时间短说明身体适应能力强，训练效果好: A short recovery time indicates strong adaptation and good training results
map.踢腿高度与柔韧度转换关系: Kick height and flexibility conversion relationship
map.武术抗击打硬度评估工具，从承受力、耐痛性、恢复速度、训练经验四维度综合评估抗击打: A martial-arts strike-absorbing hardness assessment tool that comprehensively evaluates conditioning across four dimensions: force tolerance, pain tolerance, recovery speed, and training experience.

map.输入身体各部位抗击打测试数据（如压痛等级），评估该部位的硬度与抗击打能力等级，用: Enter strike-absorbing test data for each body part (such as pressure-pain grade) to assess its hardness and conditioning level, for monitoring and comparing martial-arts training results.
